name: Static & Silence, Book 2: The Journey Home
description: The defining masterpiece of the post-grunge era. A harrowing, autobiographical concept album detailing frontman Julian Croft's survival of abuse, his cross-country escape, and his return to the 'Safe Harbor'.
subtitle: 2001 Double Rock Opera — Book 2: The Journey Home
linerNotes: Part 2 of The Paper Wall's defining rock opera masterpiece, chronicling Leo's harrowing cross-country escape on a Greyhound bus, Luna's non-verbal flute lifeline ("Kaleidoscope Sun"), and his triumphant return to the Safe Harbor of his sisters and Olivia.

studioArchives.title: The Safe Harbor Lineup
studioArchives.content: Featuring Julian Croft ("Leo") on lead vocals and composition, Maya Sterling ("Olivia") on percussion and vocals, and the Croft sisters—Izzy ("Luna"), Bea ("Stella"), and Charlotte—forming a protective wall of sound.
